1.web: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
1.asv: Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,

2.web: both low and high, rich and poor together.
2.asv: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.

3.web: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart shall utter understanding.
3.asv: My mouth shall speak wisdom; And the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

4.web: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will open my riddle on the harp.
4.asv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

5.web: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
5.asv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, When iniquity at my heels compasseth me about?

6.web: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
6.asv: They that trust in their wealth, And boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

7.web: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
7.asv: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him

8.web: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
8.asv: (For the redemption of their life is costly, And it faileth for ever),

9.web: That he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
9.asv: That he should still live alway, That he should not see corruption.

10.web: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
10.asv: For he shall see it. Wise men die; The fool and the brutish alike perish, And leave their wealth to others.

11.web: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
11.asv: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, Andtheir dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.

12.web: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
12.asv: But man being in honor abideth not: He is like the beasts that perish.

13.web: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
13.asv: This their way is their folly: Yet after them men approve their sayings. [Selah

14.web: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
14.asv: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol; Death shall be their shepherd: And the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their beauty shall be for Sheol to consume, That there be no habitation for it.

15.web: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
15.asv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol; For he will receive me. [Selah

16.web: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased.
16.asv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, When the glory of his house is increased:

17.web: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away. His glory shall not descend after him.
17.asv: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.

18.web: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
18.asv: Though while he lived he blessed his soul (And men praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself),

19.web: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
19.asv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light.

20.web: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
20.asv: Man that is in honor, and understandeth not, Is like the beasts that perish.
